bindings.checkpoint_and_training_receipt: same clean source, complete exposure, architecture, seed, optimizer arm, data receipt and checkpoint SHA-256
bindings.functional_health: exact checkpoint SHA-256, architecture, seed, final exposure and selected validation identity
bindings.teacher: constant baseline, selected validation role and every run use the same source commit, producer, Run 6B network and label contract
bindings.training: constant-baseline training identity exactly matches every checkpoint and training receipt
bindings.validation: every checkpoint, training receipt and functional-health receipt exactly match the authenticated selected-role identity
bindings.wdl_calibration: constant baseline, calibration artifact, every checkpoint and every training receipt use the same artifact identity and lookup bytes

evaluation.arithmetic: checkpoint float32 CPU forward, integer score truncation and rule-50 damping, frozen float32 WDL lookup, binary64 record-order reduction
evaluation.constant_policy: reuse the two training-fitted integer constants without refitting
evaluation.mate_policy: exclude abs(teacher score) >= 31507 from the score term and retain every result term
evaluation.normalization: divide every composite sum by all selected-role records
evaluation.paired_delta: constant baseline mean minus checkpoint mean on the same records

inputs.constant_baseline: HORDE_V2_C2_CONSTANT_BASELINE_RECEIPT_V1 fitted on the authenticated training split
inputs.runs: three complete final checkpoints and their canonical training receipts
inputs.wdl_calibration: the exact HORDE_WDL_CALIBRATION_V1 used by the constant baseline and every checkpoint

matrix.one_factor_only: each arm differs from the frozen optimizer recipe in exactly one learning-rate multiplier

statistics.warning: game_ply and record adjacency must not be used to reconstruct unauthenticated game clusters
